name: Kisszállás (Hungary)
description: Blue over green with a yellow triangle at the hoist extending as a narrow yellow stripe along the centre to the fly, charged in the triangle with the municipal arms of Kisszállás (a blue shield with a white lamb and a green base, with a helm and mantling).
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kisszállás arms with helm and mantling
